outline:
本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生閱讀理解、字彙建構、以及語言解析能力。教材著重於科學、科技以及工程方面的文章，並藉由課堂延展活動增進學生於科學、科技以及工程領域的英語能力。
The course provides students with explicit, skill-based instruction in learning how to process and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skill development, vocabulary building, and language analysis. Selected readings will be centered around science, technology, and engineering. Extension activities are designed to improve students’ technical English skills to be used in the fields of science, technology, and engineering.

**113-2 Syllabus 課程表

Week Content
Week 1 Introduction (培力英檢考試說明及答題技巧分析)

Week 3 Unit 2: Science and Tech Vocabulary II
Week 4 Unit 3: Technical and science reading I
Week 5 Unit 4: Technical and science reading II
Week 6 Unit 5: Technical and science reading III
Week 7 Unit 6: Technical and science reading IV
Week 8 Unit 7: Review
Week 9 Midterm Exam
Week 10 Unit 8: Presentation I
Week 11 Unit 9: Presentation II
Week 12 Unit 10: Science News Analysis
Week 13 Unit 11: Engineering Discussion in Engineering ethics and sustainability issues
Week 14 Unit 12: Communication for workplace
Week 15 Unit 13: Technical Manuals/Reports/Papers
Week 16 Unit 14: Discussion
Week 17 Unit 15: Review
Week 18 Final Exam

Note: Adjustments are made according to instructor's actual teaching schedule and students’ classroom performance and learning outcomes.
